_comment: Oracle AI Database@AZURE Exadata Dedicated shape catalogue.
Verified against source_url on 2026-11-23; available shapes vary by region, zone and account.
Documented models are Exadata.X9M, Exadata.X11M and Exadata.X11MV.
X10M is not documented for these multicloud offerings; it is not a planned launch.
Saved shapes outside this catalogue remain visible as not in catalogue.
Edit this file or use the shape catalogue editor at /regions.
X9M server-type selectors are disabled in the documented console flow; leave lists empty for provider defaults.
X11M uses X11M / X11M-HC; X11MV uses X11MV / X11MV-HC.
No EF storage variant is confirmed by the multicloud provisioning guide.
server_types_required retains the existing X11M requirement; no new provider requirement is inferred for X11MV.
